purpose: Freeze the software/scientific interface that converts qualified multisource regulatory programs into candidate privileged teacher features without leaking validation outcomes or confusing evidence statistics with state coordinates.

required: authorized direct privileged measurements for the training unit
observation-operator descriptors only if prospectively qualified
forbidden: disease/pathology fields used to select representation
dataset ID/donor ID as biological state
post-hoc source weights chosen from validation agreement

output.semantics: Z_reg_candidate is the richer teacher regulatory state before RNA recoverability partitioning. It is not automatically a student target.

construction_rules: Teacher feature coordinates must be constructed from direct authorized training-population measurements and frozen regulatory programs, not from aggregate Stage-4 significance statistics.
Unavailable privileged programs stay masked/unavailable and may increase uncertainty; they are never zero-filled as measured biology.
If latent coordinates rotate across fits, authority attaches to the stable subspace/geometry unless basis stability separately qualifies coordinate identities.
Source disagreement remains encoded in provenance/uncertainty or blocks the program under the prospective disagreement policy; it cannot be solved by favorable source selection.
Representation dimension and any compression method are frozen using TRAIN/VALIDATION only before recoverability TEST is opened.

No program enters Z_reg_candidate unless it passes the prospective teacher-candidate selection contract or is explicitly retained as an unqualified diagnostic channel that cannot supervise the student.

postconstruction.shared_rule: Only donor-held-out RNA-recoverable components/subspaces can become Z_reg_shared.
postconstruction.private_rule: Unrecoverable privileged information remains Z_reg_private and is never forced into the RNA student loss.
postconstruction.test_rule: recoverability TEST stays sealed until construction, projection, baselines, metrics and decision rules are frozen.

anti_leakage_assertions: No protected validation outcome participates in feature construction.
No evidence-source agreement score becomes a per-cell feature.
No direct ATAC/SCENIC+/perturbation value enters the RNA student inference schema.
No missingness mask may reveal a protected outcome label.
